//LanguageModel: ADR 2 - Google Gemini free tier. The key is never in the repository: set LanguageModel__ApiKey as an environment variable, or dotnet user-secrets locally. With no key the API starts normally and every agent still answers, using its deterministic path.
//LanguageModel.tuning: Common, group-owned - every agent shares this. Model/ThinkingBudget/TimeoutSeconds/TotalBudgetSeconds below are tuned against the live API (2026-09-21), not guessed: gemini-3.5-flash measured ~5x faster than 3.6 on the same key and prompt (switched to gemini-3.5-flash-lite on 2026-09-26, not yet re-measured), ThinkingBudget must sit under thinkingConfig (thinkingLevel is a 400 on this API version) and stays null because flash-lite rejects it with a 400, and TotalBudgetSeconds is 3x TimeoutSeconds plus backoff. See LanguageModelOptions.cs for the full reasoning per field. Don't change these without re-measuring - each one broke the agent silently the first time and cost a full session to trace.
//Emergency.DemoFleet: Nobody carries a crew phone for the demo ambulances, so DemoFleetLocationWorker reports each one near its parking spot every IntervalMinutes. It skips an ambulance on a live run or one a real phone reported in the last minute. Turn it off for a real deployment.
